headline: YouTube brothers' company fined 140,000 kroner over vodka-smuggling video
deck: The Consumer Ombudsman had sought 250,000 kroner; the case also covered undeclared paid promotion for KiMs.
standard: Kender Du Det ApS, the company of the YouTube brothers Elias and Oskar Hole, was fined 140,000 kroner on Friday for several breaches of the Marketing Practices Act.

The case centred on a 2023 video showing their more than 310,000 followers eight ways to smuggle alcohol into festivals, and on undeclared paid promotion for KiMs. The Consumer Ombudsman had sought 250,000 kroner. The company must also pay the costs of the case.

Miriam Michaelsen, a lawyer and chair of Medierådet for Børn og Unge, the media council for children and young people, tells Kristeligt Dagblad that the ruling shows influencers bear a responsibility, and expects more such cases.
short: Kender Du Det ApS, the company of the YouTube brothers Elias and Oskar Hole, was fined 140,000 kroner on Friday for breaches of the Marketing Practices Act, including over a video about smuggling alcohol into festivals.
